mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for late morning and sink_k1 for late night. On Day 26, it was at sink_k1 at 15:49 (afternoon) and cupboard_k1 at 22:13 (late night). The assumption that it stays at the desk during work hours is incorrect for afternoon queries; check sink_k1 for afternoon (14:00-18:00). The assumption that it moves to the sink overnight is incorrect; check cupboard_k1 for late night (22:00+).

charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late night. On Day 26, it was at desk_o1 at 17:26 (late afternoon). The assumption that it moves to the nightstand by late afternoon is incorrect. Check desk_o1 for late afternoon (16:00-18:00) queries, as Tomas is working from home. Keep checking nightstand_b1 for very late night (22:00+) if not found at desk.

glass_tomas: Previous notes suggested cupboard_k1 for late night based on Day 25. On Day 26, it was at kitchen_table_k1 at 12:56 (mid-day) and nightstand_b1 at 22:54 (late night). The cupboard_k1 pattern is inconsistent. Check kitchen_table_k1 for mid-day (12:00-14:00) queries. For late night (22:00+), check nightstand_b1 first, as it returned there on Day 26.
